samples.title: Teacher Agency in Implementing Automated Writing Evaluation Systems in a Science Classroom: A Focus Group Study

samples.method: Focus group and thematic analysis; perceived tool benefits/constraints, not student learning experiment.
samples.exclusion_reason: Not current-week first-public evidence; no causal student outcomes; full text unavailable in preview.

samples.title: Teaching Machine Learning to Senior Primary Students: Evaluating a Course for AI Literacy in a Hong Kong Primary School
samples.school_stage: Grade 6; one Hong Kong primary school.
samples.method: Convenience sample 145 pupils; six-hour course; pre/post concepts test and 15-pupil focus groups; Wilcoxon and thematic analysis. Single group; no comparator described in inspected methods.
samples.exclusion_reason: Not current-week news; single-school pre/post supports descriptive change, not causal efficacy or broad transfer.
high_risk_questions: Independently verify analysed denominator/missing data rather than treat recruited 145 as all analysed.
Check test reliability and no-control limitation before any effects claim.
Full/short classification not confirmed by Articles label or six-page length.
PDF prose calling Teachable Machine GPT-like needs technical caution, not adoption as fact.
